svg.title: SPY 2026-09-03 orbit
svg.desc: Orbit of SPY on 2026-09-03: horizontal is price velocity, vertical is price acceleration, from a centred Savitzky-Golay fit of 11 observations, degree 3, one-minute spacing, 5 observations lost at each edge of each run. 369 observations drawn in time order; the path is not closed. Colour is the note each observation quantised to, thirty degrees of hue per semitone from A. Missing minutes 264 end a run; nothing is drawn across them. Axes are scaled to this session's own extremes; this is a preview, not a fixed scale.
svg.text: SPY · 2026-09-03 · velocity × acceleration · 369 observations · preview scaling
